title: Daily rewards
subtitle: The 30-day template repeats cyclically and applies to calendar days. The regular reward is coins only; premium can be coins, diamonds or cards. Both require {{xp}} XP to claim.

template.title: {{days}}-day template (reference)
template.description: Set the regular and premium reward for each day. This template repeats in the calendar.

calendar.title: Rewards calendar
calendar.description: Replace the reward for a specific day with a separate one, detached from the template (override). Changes are only possible from tomorrow onwards — today and past days are locked.

editor.title: Configure reward
editor.name: Reward name (optional)
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: A short note about the reward...
editor.activeHint: Active (if turned off, this day/tier reward will not be given)
editor.replaceAvatar: Replace this avatar reward by selecting diamonds or another category and entering the amount.
editor.invalidAmount: The amount must be a whole number between 1 and 2147483647.

premiumForm.discountHint: The discount price must be lower than the original price

calendarForm.cycleHelp: Cycle length: {{length}}. The anchor date counts as day 1.
